who_2008_checked_against: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations in the Western Pacific Region (2008), PDF text parsed locally (not redistributed)
note: Low overlap values came from wording differences; all 7 flagged points were hand-read against the WHO sentence and have the same meaning.

hand_read_verdicts.BL5: Same meaning: WHO "1 B-cun superior to the anterior hairline, 1.5 B-cun lateral to the anterior median line" vs AcuAtlas "1 body-cun behind the anterior hairline and 1.5 body-cun lateral to the midline". Difference is wording only.
hand_read_verdicts.BL7: Same meaning: WHO 4 B-cun superior to anterior hairline, 1.5 B-cun lateral to anterior median line (midway between BL6 and BL8). AcuAtlas: 4 body-cun behind hairline, 1.5 lateral.
hand_read_verdicts.GB13: Same meaning: WHO 0.5 B-cun superior to anterior hairline, 3 B-cun lateral to anterior median line. AcuAtlas: 0.5 above hairline, 3 lateral. (WHO adds the GV24-ST8 junction note, not in AcuAtlas.)
hand_read_verdicts.CV24: Same meaning: WHO "in the depression in the centre of the mentolabial sulcus" vs AcuAtlas "center of the groove between the lower lip and the chin".
